chapter: Eddie Heywood, the organ and later work
title: Touring with Tom Jones, Basie and Gladys Knight
summary: He went on a national tour in 1969-70 with Tom Jones, Count Basie and Gladys Knight.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: After '68... In '69 and '70 I went there and accompanied Tom Jones a little. He was at Tucson, and I gave him a call. I gave him a call at Tucson; he was resting up there. That's the last time I spoke to T-Bone. That was in '70.
You were on the road with Tom Jones.
You called him in Tucson when you were in L.A.

In L.A., yeah. I went with Tom Jones in '69 and '70, on the road show. We flew out to California in a private plane, together with Count Basie and Gladys Knight and the Pips, playing the (?)... I mean, it was a national tour, and Basie would leave at a certain point to go on his tour, and we had to pick up another band, and then later
Basie joined again. But Gladys Knight was there throughout. And Crosby, a comedian...
No, not Bill. Mel Crosby or something like that. [INAUDIBLE SENTENCE]
